---
title: Factory definition reference
description: Every field of a factory definition, with its type, whether it is required, its default and what it means.
---

<!-- Generated by tools/gendocs. Do not edit; source: contracts/definitions/factory.schema.json. Run task docs:ref:gen. -->

One file defines a factory: its runtime, the organization connections and knowledge sources it uses, skills, agents, board and learning loop.

Fields are listed in the schema's order, each nested under the field that holds it. The fields under an array are those of each of its elements, and the fields under a map are those of each of its values.

## apiVersion

`"goal/v1"`, required.

## kind

`"Factory"`, required.

## metadata

object, required.

- `id`: string matching `^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$`, required. Immutable UUID. Keys the database rows and bucket prefixes, so the name and folder can change freely.
- `name`: string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9]$`, required. Human-friendly slug shown in the UI and CLI. Safe to rename.
- `title`: string.
- `purpose`: string. What the factory is for, in one or two sentences. Agents read it before every item.
- `description`: string. Deprecated alias of purpose, read when purpose is absent.
- `owner`: string.

## spec

object, required.

- `runtime`: object, required.
  - `model`: string matching `^claude-[a-z0-9-]+$`.
  - `modelConnection`: string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9]$`. The organization connection that gives every run its model: one of a kind with model access (anthropic, claude-subscription, bedrock).
  - `size`: one of `"small"`, `"medium"`, `"large"`. How much CPU and memory each run's box gets; medium when omitted.
  - `tools`: array of string. mise tool specs (go@1.26.10, npm:@acme/cli@2) every run installs after the repository's own mise.toml or .tool-versions.
  - `repository`: object. The git repository cloned into each run's box before the agent starts, on the item's branch (goal/&lt;number&gt;-&lt;slug&gt;).
    - `url`: string matching `^https://[^/@]+/.+`, required. https clone URL without credentials
    - `connection`: string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9]$`. The organization connection that clones and merges: one whose kind logs git in to the URL's host. Omit it for a public repository.
    - `token`: string. Removed in phase 4 (env-reference-removed): set connection. Accepted so versions published before still load; goald does not run them.
  - `runner`: one of `"docker"`, `"ecs"`. Removed in phase 4 (field-removed): the platform chooses the sandbox backend.
  - `image`: string. Removed in phase 4 (field-removed): every run uses the platform's agent image.
  - `auth`: one of `"claude-subscription"`, `"anthropic-api-key"`, `"bedrock"`. Removed in phase 4 (field-removed): set modelConnection.
  - `budget`: object.
    - `dailyUsd`: number.
    - `weeklyUsd`: number. Spend cap over a rolling 7 days.
    - `onExhausted`: one of `"drain"`, `"stop"`. At the weekly cap: drain starts no new agent work and lets running tasks finish; stop also stops them. Default drain.
    - `perItemUsd`: number.
    - `maxTurnsPerTask`: integer.
- `connections`: array of string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9]$` or object. The organization's connections the factory uses, by name. Each agent's connections name entries of this list; runtime.modelConnection and runtime.repository.connection go to every run without being listed.
  - `connector`: string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*[a-z0-9](@[A-Za-z0-9._-]+)?$`, required. A catalog connector, curated or org-private: name, or name@version.
  - `name`: string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9]$`. Unique in the factory; defaults to the connector's name.
  - `credential`: string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9]$`.
  - `agents`: array of string. Agents that may use the connection; tools may narrow it further.
  - `tools`: map of object. Overrides of the catalog's per-tool defaults, by served tool name (&lt;connection&gt;\_\_&lt;tool&gt;).
    - `enabled`: boolean. false: the tool is never served.
    - `agents`: array of string. A subset of the connection's agents.
    - `approval`: one of `"required"`, `"none"`.
    - `scope`: string. A scope the connector declares.
    - `access`: string. The catalog's class for the tool; accepted, never required.
  - `type`: one of `"builtin"`, `"mcp"`, `"aws"`, required.
  - `transport`: one of `"http"`, `"stdio"`, required; only when `type` is `"mcp"`.
  - `url`: string (uri); only when `type` is `"mcp"`.
  - `image`: string; only when `type` is `"mcp"`. stdio: the MCP server's container image, run by goald as a hardened sidecar for each run that uses the connection. Pin it: a version tag (not latest) or a digest (name:1.2.3@sha256:...). Validation warns about an unpinned image and the gateway does not start one.
  - `command`: array of string; only when `type` is `"mcp"`. stdio: arguments that replace the image's command (its entrypoint is kept). Words that are secret references (env:NAME) are resolved on the host.
  - `headers`: map of string; only when `type` is `"mcp"`.
  - `env`: map of string; only when `type` is `"mcp"`. stdio: the sidecar's environment. References are resolved on the host and reach only the sidecar, never the agent's container.
  - `network`: boolean, default `false`; only when `type` is `"mcp"`. stdio: give the sidecar outbound network access (Docker's default bridge; host.docker.internal is the host). Without it the sidecar has no network at all, which suits servers that only work on their stdio. Servers that browse, call APIs or reach a database need it.
  - `roleArn`: string matching `^arn:aws:iam::\d{12}:role/.+$`, required; only when `type` is `"aws"`.
  - `region`: string; only when `type` is `"aws"`.
- `knowledge`: object.
  - `sources`: array of string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9]$`. The organization's knowledge sources the factory's agents may search, by name.
- `knowledgeBase`: object. Removed in phase 4 (field-removed): set knowledge.sources. Accepted so versions published before still load; goald does not run them.
  - `collections`: array of string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9]$`, required.
  - `retrieval`: object.
    - `topK`: integer.
  - `ingestion`: object.
    - `schedule`: string.
- `secrets`: object. Removed in phase 4 (field-removed): connections hold credentials. Accepted so versions published before still load; goald does not run them.
  - `provider`: one of `"env"`, `"aws-secrets-manager"`, `"1password"`, required.
  - `vault`: string.
- `skills`: array of object.
  - `name`: string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9]$`, required.
  - `source`: string matching `^(\./.+|skills\.sh:[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+@[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+)$`, required. A local folder (./skills/x) or a skills.sh reference (skills.sh:owner/repo@skill), pinned by the lockfile.
  - `origin`: string matching `^skills\.sh:[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+/[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+@[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+#[0-9a-f]{40}$`. Where a vendored skill came from: the skills.sh skill and the commit it was copied at. The source stays the local folder (./skills/&lt;name&gt;) it was copied into. Written by the builder; read-only in the UI.
- `rules`: array of object. Factory rules (ADR 0014): always-on guidance for the agents each rule's appliesTo targets. Each is a markdown file under rules/ with frontmatter (description, appliesTo, paths).
  - `name`: string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9]$`, required.
  - `source`: string matching `^\./rules/.+\.md$`, required. The rule's markdown file inside the definition, under rules/ (./rules/secrets.md).
- `contracts`: map of string. Named JSON Schemas that station outputs must satisfy. An output contract becomes the model's tool input\_schema, so its top level must be "type": "object" with no oneOf, anyOf or allOf there (nested under a property is fine).
- `agents`: array of object, required.
  - `name`: string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9]$`, required.
  - `description`: string.
  - `prompt`: string, required.
  - `model`: string matching `^claude-[a-z0-9-]+$`.
  - `maxTurns`: integer. Overrides runtime.budget.maxTurnsPerTask for this agent.
  - `perItemUsd`: number. Overrides runtime.budget.perItemUsd for this agent.
  - `skills`: array of string.
  - `connections`: array of string.
  - `tools`: object. Custom rules in Claude Code's permission syntax. builtins replaces them; an agent has one or the other.
    - `allow`: array of string.
    - `deny`: array of string.
  - `builtins`: object. Built-in tools by group, each off, ask or allowed; an omitted group is off. ask is served as off until tool approvals cover built-in tools.
    - `read`: one of `"off"`, `"ask"`, `"allowed"`. Read, Grep, Glob
    - `edit`: one of `"off"`, `"ask"`, `"allowed"`. Edit, Write
    - `run`: object or one of `"off"`, `"ask"`, `"allowed"`. Bash: a mode, or a mode and the commands it may run (Bash(&lt;command&gt;:\*) each).
      - `mode`: one of `"off"`, `"ask"`, `"allowed"`, required.
      - `commands`: array of string matching `^[A-Za-z0-9_.+-]+$`.
    - `web`: one of `"off"`, `"ask"`, `"allowed"`. WebFetch, WebSearch
    - `subagents`: one of `"off"`, `"ask"`, `"allowed"`. Task
- `board`: object, required.
  - `workTypes`: array of string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9]$`.
  - `triggers`: array of object. Rules that turn an event, a schedule or a webhook delivery into a work item (ADR 0026). Each name is unique within the factory.
    - `name`: string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9]$`, required. Names the trigger in the API, the UI and the firing log; unique within the factory.
    - `enabled`: boolean, default `true`. A disabled trigger matches nothing.
    - `on`: string matching `^(github\.check_run\.failed|github\.issues\.labeled|schedule|webhook\.[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9](\.[A-Za-z0-9_][A-Za-z0-9_.-]*)?)$`, required. The event key: github.check\_run.failed, github.issues.labeled, schedule, or webhook.&lt;endpoint name&gt; with an optional .&lt;event&gt; matched against the delivery's event field.
    - `cron`: string. When on is schedule, and only then: five cron fields (minute, hour, day of month, month, day of week).
    - `timeZone`: string. When on is schedule, and only then: the IANA time zone the cron is read in. Defaults to UTC.
    - `filter`: object. Filters on the event's fields; every one given must match.
      - `branch`: string. The event's branch equals this.
      - `repo`: string. The event's repository, owner/name, equals this.
      - `label`: string. The event's label equals this.
      - `paths`: array of string. Globs; the event matches when any changed path matches one.
      - `authors`: array of string. The event's sender is one of these.
      - `skipBots`: boolean. Drop events whose sender is a bot.
    - `only`: object. Checks made before an item is created, in this order.
      - `failuresInARow`: integer. Passes when the same check failed on the last n events for it.
      - `dedupe`: string matching `^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*(\.[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*)*$`. An event field, dotted (check.name); passes when no open item this trigger created holds the same value of it.
      - `modelAgrees`: object. The model check, run last: passes when a model answers yes to the question about the event, which it reads as untrusted data.
        - `question`: string, required. The yes or no question the model answers about the event: not blank, at most 500 characters.
        - `connection`: string. The organization connection that pays for the check; runtime.modelConnection when unset.
        - `model`: string. The model asked; the connection kind's default when unset.
    - `create`: object, required. The item the trigger creates.
      - `type`: string, required. One of board.workTypes.
      - `station`: string, required. The station id the item starts at.
      - `lane`: string. The item's lane: a key of that station's route.
      - `expedite`: boolean. Put the item in the expedite flow.
      - `title`: string. The item's title; {{field}} placeholders take the event's fields.
      - `brief`: string. The item's brief; {{field}} placeholders take the event's fields, which reach agents only as untrusted data.
    - `limits`: object. Caps on what the trigger creates.
      - `perDay`: integer. At most this many items created by the trigger since the start of the UTC day.
      - `pauseOnBudget`: boolean. Skip events while the factory's budget is spent (today the weekly budget).
  - `intake`: array of object. Deprecated and ignored: nothing reads it, and board.triggers replaces it (ADR 0026). Still accepted so existing definitions load.
    - `source`: one of `"manual"`, `"github-issues"`, `"schedule"`, `"webhook"`, `"email"`, required.
    - `repo`: string.
    - `labels`: array of string.
    - `cron`: string.
    - `template`: string.
    - `type`: string.
  - `stations`: array of object, required.
    - `id`: string matching `^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{1,38}[a-z0-9]$`, required.
    - `name`: string. Display name; id stays the key everything references.
    - `description`: string. The note shown under the station.
    - `kind`: one of `"queue"`, `"agent"`, `"human"`, `"done"`, required.
    - `agent`: string.
    - `route`: map of string or object. Pick the agent by the item's lane instead of one fixed agent, e.g. { backend: backend-engineer, frontend: frontend-engineer }. An entry is an agent name or { agent, agents }: an entry with agents: n gets n of the station's slots kept for its lane, and that lane uses no others; entries without a count share the station's remaining slots. The counts add up to at most the station's agents.
      - `agent`: string, required.
      - `agents`: integer. Slots of the station kept for this lane; the lane uses no others.
    - `agents`: integer. Parallel agent containers at this station.
    - `wip`: integer. Max items in progress at this station.
    - `buffer`: integer. Items kept ready in front of the station (use at the constraint).
    - `output`: string. Name of a contract the station's result must satisfy.
    - `checks`: array of object.
      - `kind`: one of `"schema"`, `"evidence-links"`, `"command"`, required.
      - `min`: integer.
      - `run`: string.
    - `action`: one of `"merge"`. On a human station or an agent station with a gate: what goald does when the human or the gate approves. merge merges every pull request the item's outputs name first (the pull\_request and pull\_requests fields of each station's latest output, the gate's own included), each through the factory's code host connection for its host; at a gate goald merges as the engine, and a refused merge blocks the item at the gate.
    - `context`: array of one of `"inflight"`. What goald preloads into the feedback of every run at this station. inflight: an In flight section listing up to 30 of the factory's open items and assemblies with the paths each expects to change, ranked by overlap with the item.
    - `gate`: object.
      - `onReject`: string, required.
      - `maxRework`: integer.
  - `flow`: object.
    - `expedite`: object.
      - `types`: array of string.
      - `wip`: integer.
    - `constraint`: string. auto, or a station id.
    - `release`: one of `"drum-buffer-rope"`, `"push"`.
    - `andon`: object.
      - `reworkRate`: number.
      - `window`: integer.
    - `targets`: object. What the line aims for; flow metrics show each against its target. Omit a target to have none.
      - `throughputPerDay`: number. Items done per day.
      - `leadTimeHours`: number. p85 lead time, created to done, in hours.
      - `expediteLeadTimeMinutes`: integer. Lead time of each expedite item, in minutes.
    - `assemblies`: object. How runs keep item branches fresh, what a merge conflict does, whether items that edit the same files are built together whether a station's plan becomes an assembly, whether later runs hear what changed since a plan and whether an assembly's parts merge into an integration branch. Omitted keys take their defaults.
      - `freshBase`: one of `"rebase"`, `"merge"`. How a run brings an existing item branch up to date with the default branch; default rebase.
      - `onConflict`: one of `"rework"`, `"human"`. What a merge conflict does: send the item back as rework (default) or leave it to a person.
      - `overlap`: one of `"serialize"`, `"allow"`. serialize (the default): an item whose files overlap those of an item in flight waits for it; allow: build them in parallel.
      - `materialize`: boolean. true (the default): a station whose output has a non-empty plan (\[{key, title, lane, brief, paths, needs}\]) makes the item an assembly, its parts queued at that station; false: the plan is ignored and the item moves on.
      - `changedSince`: boolean. true: a station with context \[inflight\] that finishes an item records the default branch's head of runtime.repository as its base commit (a plan's parts inherit it), and every later run of the item gets a Changed since your plan section listing the commits since then that changed files its paths match. false (the default): nothing is recorded.
      - `integration`: object. Whether an assembly's parts merge into one integration branch, goal/a&lt;root number&gt;-&lt;root title slug&gt;, that lands on the default branch at a gate (ADR 0033). Omitted keys take their defaults.
        - `mode`: one of `"trunk"`, `"branch"`. trunk (the default): each part merges into the default branch. branch: an assembly's parts merge into its integration branch, which lands at the landing station; the line needs a station with action merge.
        - `refresh`: one of `"onLand"`, `"eachPart"`. When the integration branch takes in the default branch: onLand (the default), when it lands, or eachPart, before each part runs.
        - `minParts`: integer. The fewest parts an assembly needs for an integration branch; one with fewer stays on trunk. Default 0.
        - `landAt`: string. The station where the integration branch lands: an agent station with a gate and action merge. Default: the first station with action merge after the station whose plan made the assembly.
    - `dependencies`: object. Which station output fields set an item's dependencies. The platform names no field; an omitted key maps none.
      - `paths`: string. The top-level output field whose list of file globs replaces the item's paths when a station finishes with a non-empty one. Items whose paths overlap wait for each other under assemblies.overlap serialize.
      - `after`: string. The output property listing the open items of this factory, outside the output's plan, that the work must follow, as item refs &lt;factory&gt;#&lt;number&gt;. Each becomes a linked edge from the item, or from every part of its plan with no in-plan needs; a ref that is malformed, of another factory, unknown, done, cancelled or would close a cycle fails the output.
    - `retry`: object. How often a claim runs an item again after a failure that is not the item's fault. Omitted keys take their defaults.
      - `transient`: object. Runs whose sandbox was lost to its infrastructure (a redeploy, a box restart, a network blip): each runs again in a new box after a backoff that doubles with each loss.
        - `attempts`: integer. The most runs one claim makes when its sandbox is lost; the loss that reaches it blocks the item. Default 3.
- `learning`: object.
  - `librarian`: object.
    - `agent`: string, required.
    - `after`: array of string. Stations whose completion triggers the librarian.
    - `writes`: array of string.
  - `kaizen`: object.
    - `schedule`: string.
  - `jonah`: object. The reviews that turn sent-back runs into proposals for the definition (ADR 0034).
    - `enabled`: boolean, default `true`. Whether sent-back runs queue reviews at all.
    - `proposeAfter`: integer, default `5`. The sent-back touches that queue a review, and the times an observation is seen before it becomes a proposal.
    - `weeklyUsd`: number, default `10`. What the review runs may cost over the last 7 days, in USD.
    - `model`: string matching `^claude-[a-z0-9-]+$`. The review run's model; runtime.model when omitted.

## starter

object. What a new factory made from this definition starts with (ADR 0032). Onboarding submits starter.item once, when the factory has no items yet.

- `item`: object, required. A small, safe first item the person watches go through the line.
  - `title`: string, required. The item's title.
  - `type`: string. One of board.workTypes; when absent, the item gets the first work type, as submitItem does.
  - `body`: string. The item's brief, in markdown.
